reason: Complete serving callers, S3 upload/presigning helpers, MIME allowlist and both exact-commit nginx files inspected. Before, a .png filename could select inline even when the browser-supplied/stored content type was text/html. Upload already stores attachment disposition for types outside the allowlist, which excludes text/html. Corrected shared/token callers stop deciding from the extension; serve_s3 stops adding its own disposition, and nginx stops hiding S3's disposition. Forced downloads only override to attachment, and the nginx cache key includes that override. Preserve the non-Python configuration and unchanged MIME module by review-time byte hashes at this fixing commit. Scope is production S3 serving described by CVE-2023-22735, not local disk, every legacy stored object, or independently reproduced browser behavior.
